rules.note: Every spec needs an index row. README.md itself is the owner.
App/broker split contract: mTLS Gateway control, cert lifecycle, role env checks. Recurring runbook drift class (DOC-002/006/009/010/017/018/019).
Who FastAPI trusts without a JWT (loopback, tailnet, the private-net /health probe). Both owners restated the 10.0.0.0/16 scope wrongly after REL-170 (DOC-020/022).

operations.md is the one place indexing all five nightly loops: fire times, clone + marker rails, the model pin and the status vocabulary an operator reads off a page. #219 changed operator-facing behaviour in all five wrappers with no owner update (DOC-032/033/034/040). Loop SEMANTICS stay in .claude/skills/<loop>/SKILL.md; only the operator contract belongs here.
Cache semantics and the vendor ladder are the reader-facing contract: a cached hit keeps its original source, and errors[] is not missing (DOC-065).
The Credentials tab refuses values on egress pins an operator cannot see from the UI (DOC-067).
Probe sources, degraded_reasons and the dwell suppressions decide what an operator is paged for (DOC-074).
When a duplicate-only or empty pull is an error vs expected is the on-call discriminator (DOC-078).
Sandbox setup that runs inside the radon checkout for the sibling Foreman app.
GitHub front door. Root README.md is pinned by TestThinIndex, not this glob: a bare README.md glob matches every nested README via basename.
Store-wins-over-.env precedence, master-key loss recovery, and setup-mode entry/exit are operator contracts (DOC-051).
